title: Rabbi Chanina bar Idi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: A precious saying of his remains to us in Taanit 7a: “Why are the words of Torah compared to water? To tell you: just as water leaves a high place and goes to a low place, so the words of Torah endure only in one whose mind is humble.” Dikdukei Soferim reads Rabbi Chanilai bar Idi; see also Rav Chinena bar Idi.

notes.text: The consulted Davidson text of Taanit 7a names Rabbi Chanina bar Idi. The Dikdukei Soferim reading Chanilai bar Idi is cited here from Hyman.
